newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to weak.

text.p: Pressure from competing feed ingredients as well as increased millfeed supplies weighed on millfeed values in nearly all areas, dealers said.

Buffalo dealers reported a slight increase in flour mill run times to about 5-1/2 days a week up from five days. Also, seasonal increases in beer and ethanol production boosted output of feed byproducts from those industries.
California sources said a greater amount of rice bran was available at about $10 per ton less than locally-offered millfeeds.
Portland dealers reported tight supplies for prompt shipment because of floods in North Dakota halted incoming shipments from that state.

North Texas millfeeds turned quiet after moderate to active trading Wednesday at $97 per ton. Dealers there said buyers appear to have immediate needs covered but were not covered for May or summer positions.
